ai.neuralVoiceHint: Replies use server TTS: xAI (Grok) when XAI_API_KEY is set — supports Russian and many other languages; otherwise Groq Orpheus with the same GROQ_API_KEY as chat when LEXORA_AI_PROVIDER=groq. On failure, the browser uses built-in speech.
ai.placeholder: Type a message or use the microphone…

ai.emptyHint: Pick a scenario and say hello — the tutor answers in your learning language.
ai.speechLangHint: Default is Auto: the browser picks a locale from your OS language list, then the site UI language — not true spoken-language detection. For reliable Russian and English in one session without switching, use Server Whisper (Groq key). In Chrome/Edge, browser STT often uses Google’s cloud; quality varies with mic and noise.
ai.micMatchSpokenHint: Pick a fixed language only if Auto guesses wrong. If nothing appears after you speak, wait for the “no speech” toast or speak a bit louder.

ai.micHint: Tap mic, speak one phrase; recording stops after a short pause. Tap mic again for another phrase. If endings look wrong, shorten the phrase or type it.
ai.micUnsupported: Speech recognition is not available in this browser.
ai.whisperHint: Short clips go to Groq Whisper — language is auto-detected (Russian and English both work well). Add GROQ_API_KEY on the server even when chat uses xAI Grok; browser speech recognition is unreliable for Russian.
ai.whisperMicHint: Record one phrase, tap stop — text appears after server transcription
